searches.reason: Establish a trustworthy foundation before interpreting context effects: every category previously failed padding invariance. Seek a diagnostic suite that localizes failures to recurrent padding updates, final-position readout, state leakage, or predictor serialization. Calibrate tolerances against repeated identical computations and verify probe sensitivity using deliberately injected bugs, while preserving the GRU4Rec interfaces.

searches.reason: Replace reliance on easy sampled-pair margins with diagnostics of ranking failures. Seek training-only prefix audits with withheld next items, fixed unique candidates, top-10 boundary margins, and history-length/item-frequency strata. Compare sampled and full-catalog ranks where affordable, reporting counts and user-level uncertainty. These remain supplementary diagnostics; the pinned host macro validation HR@10 remains the selection objective.

searches.reason: Turn qualitative complaints into testable, evidence-limited hypotheses about the single trained GRU4Rec. Seek matched history interventions and gradient attribution that distinguish recent coherent context from broad lexical overlap, with randomization controls for attribution validity. Public titles and descriptions can support lexical audits; ownership, compatibility, mood, and willingness to choose now require explicit feedback and must otherwise remain unknown.
